title: Enterprise Conversational BI: Raw Text-to-SQL vs. Governed Semantic Layer (Cube/MetricFlow) Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Raw Physical DDL Prompting -> Free-Form LLM SQL
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 41.5% wrong KPI numbers (1-to-N join fan-out) & $45K/mo runaway 50TB warehouse scans

tiers.name: Tier 2: Vector Schema-RAG + Few-Shot SQL Examples (No Semantic Layer)
tiers.verdict: Finds tables better, but LLM still hallucinates join paths & double-counts multi-grain facts

tiers.name: Tier 3: Fine-Tuned SQL Code-LLM on Historical Query Logs
tiers.verdict: Memorizes deprecated columns & legacy analyst mistakes; breaks whenever schema evolves

tiers.name: Tier 4: Governed Semantic Layer (Cube/MetricFlow) + SQLGlot AST/Dry-Run Gate + OAuth RLS
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 98.6% KPI accuracy, 0.0% runaway scans, 0.0% RLS leaks & -87.9% monthly TCO
